s10.old: **Diagnosis (measured on consoles 8806/8802, data root `C:\Users\pgoff\AppData\Local\Mentat\console`):** Fairshake was NOT excluded from the PAC evidence list. The Crypto workbook import lists it with 28 rows, but 22 were `Record Type = CORPORATE` (Coinbase treasury giving) and `TYPES` in `mentat/app/evidence_csv.py` mapped `contribution` but never `corporate`, so every corporate row in every workbook was "unsupported" (Crypto 333/333, Credit Union 202/202). Fairshake showed $1.0M instead of $177,980,393.39. The list also had no committee-type filter: one 523-entry select sorted by ID, no search, while the workbook's `Recipient Category` column and `graph_data.py` CATEGORIES already carried exactly the taxonomy Paul asked for (Super PAC, Trade Association, JFC, Company PAC, Leadership PAC, Carey, Other PAC, Candidate, Party Committee, Unclassified). The evidence reader ignored the column. The "Saved FEC snapshots" source lists only the typed committee IDs (not a defect).
s10.why: "the PAC evidence list" and "The list also had no committee-type filter" are a list in the console UI

s10.old: **Package check that changed the design:** `politicsnlp` (PyPI 0.0.21, 2023) is a political-vocabulary NLP library with no geocoding and no districts; `geopy` returns coordinates, not districts. Neither can do this job and neither is installed. What does it: the FEC candidate master already in the repo (`inputs/fec_beneficiary/cn22|cn24|cn26`) for money TO candidates, exact and instant; the Census ZCTA-to-district crosswalk for money FROM contributors, approximate and labelled; the Census cartographic district files converted once to SVG paths shipped under `app/geo/`. GeoPy stays an optional provider for the later street-address lane (S8b, not built).
